meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI-powered video and image generation software (text-to-video, image-to-video, generative creative tools)

analysis.summary: Rivals are racing to plug into chat assistants and to host Kling 4.0. Runway publishes the most how-to content, while HeyGen leads on industry landing pages.

points.text: Runway and Pika both put up Kling 4.0 pages, but Pika's says "Coming Soon" while Runway's is already live.
Three companies chased AI-assistant and agent users: Runway (MCP, Claude Marketplace), Pika (ChatGPT) and HeyGen (Manus).
HeyGen is the only rival publishing by industry: real estate, beauty and wellness, and financial services. Runway's new pages target UGC and ads instead.

Runway.play: Pushes assistant integrations, Kling 4.0 and ads, backed by 6 how-to guides.

Pika.play: Small launch burst: Kling 4.0 teaser, image editing studio, ChatGPT integration.

Luma AI.play: Teaches users through a learning center and publishes one technical research paper.

Kling AI.play: No pages in the data, so no content play to read.

HeyGen.play: Industry landing pages, avatar tools, its own video model, plus 130 templated /tool/ pages.

shared.title: Kling 4.0 and multi-model hubs
shared.text: Runway and Pika each have a Kling 4.0 page, and HeyGen sells "Top AI Video Model in One Platform". Platforms are pitching themselves as one place for many models.

shared.title: Assistant and agent integrations
shared.text: Runway (MCP, Claude Marketplace), Pika (inside ChatGPT) and HeyGen (Manus) launched pages meeting users inside other AI tools. Expect video generation to be sold as a feature of chat tools.

gaps.title: Filmmaker case studies
gaps.text: Only HeyGen published one case study, and it isn't about film. Runway could show real production teams using its tools to win over evaluators.

gaps.title: Head-to-head buyer guides
gaps.text: No company published a page comparing platforms this month. Runway could own honest comparisons for people choosing between AI video tools.

gaps.title: Filmmaker workflow content
gaps.text: Only Runway has a filmmaker's guide, and just one. Deeper pieces on pre-production, shot continuity and editing would reach a group rivals ignore.

versus.Pika: Publishes far less (3 new pages vs Runway's 10) and has no how-to or research content. It matches Runway on Kling 4.0 and chat integrations.
versus.Luma AI: Publishes almost nothing new (1 page) and leans technical and educational. Runway ships more guides and more product pages.
versus.Kling AI: No pages appear in the data, so there is nothing to compare. Runway and Pika are the ones hosting its model.
versus.HeyGen: Much larger site (584 pages) with industry landing pages and templated tool pages. Runway has more how-to content but no industry pages.
